meaning: Water inlet error: the specified amount of water was not supplied to the tub.
causes: Closed water inlet valve (for example after installation)
diySteps: Check whether the kitchen and bathroom taps have water (a water outage can cause IE)
Make sure the inlet hose is not pressed or kinked, and straighten it; check for objects pressing on it
Open the sink cabinet and check the inlet valve connected to the dishwasher and the shut-off valve above it; open each by turning it anti-clockwise
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the valves are open and IE persists, LG says a service technician needs to inspect it; contact LG support (or your installer if it was newly installed).
sourceTitle: [LG Dishwasher] Guide to Error Codes (LG USA Support)
